tools.name: search_norwegian_companies
tools.description: Find Norwegian companies in the Brønnøysund register by industry, municipality, legal form, employees, founding or registration date, website pattern and filed accounts, with optional revenue bounds. Returns name, organisation number, industry, employees, address, website, email and phone. Active co

tools.name: get_norwegian_company
tools.description: Full profile of one Norwegian company by organisation number: register details, contact information, activity, CEO, board, auditor and accountant, and the latest filed revenue and profit.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_financials
tools.description: Up to three years of filed annual accounts for a Norwegian company: revenue, operating and net profit, payroll, assets, equity, debt and cash, with growth, margin and equity ratio. Set consolidated for group accounts.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company_group
tools.description: The corporate group (konsern) a Norwegian company belongs to: the top parent and every subsidiary with ownership share. Accepts any member of the group.

tools.name: find_norwegian_industry_codes
tools.description: Look up SN2025 industry codes (the Norwegian NACE standard the register uses) by Norwegian or English words or a code prefix. Use the codes in search_norwegian_companies; a broader code such as 62 includes all its subclasses.

tools.name: find_norwegian_company_websites
tools.description: Find the websites of one to five Norwegian companies and the platform each runs on, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. Checks the registered website, the domain of the registered email and domains guessed from the company name, and confirms ownership by finding the organisation number or full company n

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_norwegian_companies, find_norwegian_company_websites · Private data: get_norwegian_company · Public sink: search_norwegian_companies, get_norwegian_company_group, find_norwegian_company_websites.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_norwegian_companies, find_norwegian_company_websites · Private data: get_norwegian_company · Public sink: search_norwegian_companies, get_norwegian_company_group, find_norwegian_company_websites

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
